_comment: P2.11 Phase 5 A/B config: current-default reopt (flag OFF, legacy full-beam walk) vs merged reopt (flag ON, sub-incremental walk + Type-E in the serialized queue). Single task count N=16, 10 tasksets, two arms. The flag is ReoptimizationUseSubIncrementalWalk in sources/parameters.yaml (line 46), read at static init by Parameters.cpp -- process-wide, so flag 0 vs flag 1 = TWO separate .sh runs with the YAML value flipped between them (no rebuild; the same release binary reads the flag from YAML at startup). Run order: (1) flag=0 run with RERUN_MODE=clear_all, (2) cp comparison_summary.csv aside, (3) flip YAML flag 0->1, (4) flag=1 run with RERUN_MODE=clear_results (reuses the identical seeded tasksets, re-simulates with the flag on), (5) cp comparison_summary.csv aside, (6) flip YAML flag back to 0. Compare the two saved CSVs (Mean_SP_Metric + Mean_Scheduler_Execution_Time_s per arm). SKIP_EVAL=1 because the north-star gates need BF/CFS/RM_FAST/RM_SLOW (not simulated here) and would report MISSING; this run is a focused 2-arm A/B, not a gate run. enable_resume_from_existing_results is deliberately FALSE so the flag=1 run re-simulates every arm instead of skipping the flag=0 results left on disk.
_comment_on_arms: INCR_Reopt_1 = reopt every interval (max-reopt stress; the flag affects every interval). INCR_Reopt_10 = reopt every 10th interval (realistic; the flag affects only every 10th). The flag only changes the ReOptimizePeriodic path; the incremental path (the other 9/10 intervals) is identical. So INCR_Reopt_1 shows the maximal flag effect, INCR_Reopt_10 shows the realistic effect. Both arms run under both flags = 4 data points per taskset. arms = main_scheduler_list only (ablation_scheduler_list empty) so the simulate union is exactly these two.
_comment_on_bin_dir: Use BIN_DIR=release (the RELEASE build, CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release). NEVER use BIN_DIR=build_test for simulation/ET runs -- that is the DEBUG build (~8.5x slower, inflates absolute scheduler ET; it exists ONLY for running ctest against GTSAM/test infra gated by CMakeLists.txt:27). The .sh build stage runs 'make -j6' in BIN_DIR -- a fast no-op against the already-current release binary (lib = libSP_OPT.so, links release/libSP_OPT.so). This is the only place in the repo that documents BIN_DIR for an A/B run, so it is the single source of truth: release. Run command: CONFIG_JSON=simulation_experiments/configs/p211_reopt_ab_config.json BIN_DIR=release SKIP_EVAL=1 RERUN_MODE=clear_all ./scripts/run_simulation_plot_eval_ns.sh

test_mode._comment_interval_sweep: num_tasks_for_single_task_figures=0 opts out of the single-task sweep + figures (Fig 2/3/1F). NOTE: the sweep's reuse_matching_interval keys on N; since the sweep N (= this key, here 0=skipped) need not equal the main N (num_tasks_for_cross_task_comparison=[8]), a non-zero value here would NOT reuse the main-step dir and would run a FULL extra N sim. So 0 here is both the opt-out AND avoids that extra sim cost. The e2e pipeline still runs sweep->aggregate structurally, but both stages no-op cleanly when this is 0.
